description:
# Link Signatures Requirements Checklist

Extracted from draft-lichen-schnorr-00.md and draft-lichen-link-01.md.

## Schnorr48 Signature Requirements (draft-lichen-schnorr-00)

### Signing/Verification
- [ ] Implementations MUST use constant-time operations for scalar multiplication
- [ ] Implementations MUST use constant-time operations for signature comparison
- [ ] Schnorr48 MUST sign application digests (e.g., 64-byte SHA-512) directly
- [ ] Schnorr48 MUST NOT hash, truncate, decode, or append NUL to application transcripts
- [ ] Random nonce generation is NOT RECOMMENDED (deterministic per RFC 6979)

### Invalid Signature Rejection
- [ ] MUST reject: wrong message for signature
- [ ] MUST reject: tampered challenge (bit flip in e)
- [ ] MUST reject: tampered response (bit flip in s)
- [ ] MUST reject: wrong public key
- [ ] MUST reject: truncated signature (<48 bytes)
- [ ] MUST reject: zero signature (48 zero bytes)

## Link Frame Requirements (draft-lichen-link-01)

### Frame Structure
- [ ] Complete frame MUST NOT exceed 255 octets
- [ ] LENGTH field MUST NOT exceed 254
- [ ] Receivers MUST discard frames with LENGTH=255
- [ ] Receivers MUST discard frames where LENGTH != (received size - 1)
- [ ] PLD using a defined dispatch value MUST be at least 2 bytes

### LLSec Byte Rules
- [ ] Receivers MUST discard frames with reserved MicLength values (0b010-0b111)
- [ ] Senders MUST leave E bit clear (no encrypted payloads)
- [ ] Receivers MUST discard frames with E=1

### Signer IID (SI/S bit) Invariants
- [ ] Signed frames (S=1) MUST also set SI=1
- [ ] Signed frames (S=1) MUST carry a valid Signer IID (8 bytes)
- [ ] Unsigned frames MUST set SI=0
- [ ] Receivers MUST discard frames with SI=1 and S=0
- [ ] Receivers MUST discard frames with S=1 and SI=0
- [ ] MUST NOT set both S=1 and E=1 (rejected before signature processing)

### Broadcast Handling
- [ ] When AddrMode=None (0b00), all nodes MUST process payload (subject to replay)

### IPv6 Source Address
- [ ] IPv6 source address MUST NOT be used as immediate signer identity
- [ ] Key selection MUST NOT depend on IPv6 source address in payload

### RPL Control Messages
- [ ] All RPL control messages (DIO, DAO, DIS) MUST be sent with S=1
- [ ] All RPL control messages MUST carry valid Schnorr signature
- [ ] Receivers MUST reject unsigned RPL control frames before routing state mutation
- [ ] Permissive mode for unsigned routing frames MUST NOT be enabled in production

### Authentication Order
- [ ] Receivers MUST authenticate frame before SCHC decompression
- [ ] Receivers MUST authenticate frame before fragment reassembly

### Replay Protection
- [ ] Each node MUST maintain a per-peer replay window
- [ ] Receivers MUST maintain replay window per (peer, epoch) pair
- [ ] Receivers MUST discard frames whose (EPO, SEQ) already accepted
- [ ] Implementations MUST compare counters using unsigned integer ordering
- [ ] Implementations MUST NOT use serial-number or modulo arithmetic for replay
- [ ] Frame MUST be discarded if EPO < highest accepted EPO for peer
- [ ] A lower EPO MUST always be rejected
- [ ] SEQ decrease under same EPO MUST NOT be accepted as wrap

### Epoch Transitions
- [ ] When SEQ=0xFFFF, sender MUST increment EPO and use SEQ=0
- [ ] EPO MUST NOT wrap from 0xFF to 0x00
- [ ] After (0xFF, 0xFFFF), sender MUST rotate link key before next authenticated frame
- [ ] Receiver MUST reject (0x00, 0x0000) under exhausted key
- [ ] After authenticating new link key, receiver MUST create fresh replay state
- [ ] On reboot, node SHOULD resume above last used counter
- [ ] Node MUST rotate link key if it cannot establish unused greater tuple
